title: IGG: A Benchmark for Interactive GUI Grounding under Visibility Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2610.32536v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: GUI grounding benchmarks ask whether an agent can localize a target that is already visible in a static screenshot. Real interfaces often violate this assumption: a target may be off-screen, appear only after a state change or hover, remain occluded, or become actionable after a delay. This leaves the ability to recover target visibility unevaluated. To measure this reveal step, we introduce Interactive GUI Grounding (IGG), a benchmark in which an agent must first make the target visible through interaction and then click it. IGG contains 601 tasks across 16 controllable GUI environments and seven visibility-constraint sub-types, with a compact action space of scrolling, moving, dragging, waiting, and clicking. In our human study, participants achieve 94.6% accuracy, while GPT-5.5 reaches 79.4% and the strongest evaluated open-source VLM reaches only 31.6%. To identify the source of this gap, we conduct two controlled interventions. Tell

translated_title: IGG：一个面向可见性约束下交互式GUI定位的基准测试
translated_abstract: 现有的GUI定位基准测试考察的是智能体能否在静态截图中定位一个已经可见的目标。然而，真实界面常常不满足这一假设：目标可能不在屏幕内、只有在状态改变或悬停后才会出现、处于被遮挡状态、或经过延迟后才变为可操作。这导致“恢复目标可见性”的能力一直未被评估。为了衡量这一揭示步骤，我们提出了交互式GUI定位基准IGG，在该基准中，智能体必须首先通过交互使目标可见，然后再点击它。IGG包含601个任务，覆盖16个可控制的GUI环境和七种可见性约束子类型，并采用紧凑的动作空间，包括滚动、移动、拖拽、等待和点击。在人类研究中，参与者达到94.6%的准确率，而GPT-5.5达到79.4%，被评测的最强开源视觉语言模型仅达到31.6%。为了找出这一差距的来源，我们进行了两项受控干预实验。
tldr: 该论文提出了IGG基准，首个要求智能体先通过交互使被隐藏的GUI目标变为可见再进行点击的评测基准，揭示了人类（94.6%）与最强模型（GPT-5.5达79.4%，最强开源模型仅31.6%）在可见性约束下GUI定位能力的显著差距。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces IGG, the first benchmark requiring agents to reveal hidden GUI targets through interaction before clicking them, revealing a substantial gap between humans (94.6%) and state-of-the-art models (GPT-5.5 at 79.4%, with the best open-source VLM reaching only 31.6%) under visibility constraints.
